name: Command Re-roll
text: Use after a friendly unit or model makes an Advance, Charge, Desperate Escape, or Hazardous roll, or a hit, wound, save, damage, or attacks-count roll. Re-roll it; for a multi-die roll, re-roll a single die of your choice instead of the whole roll.

combatPatrol.note: usable by any CP unit; Forward Outpost's Sabotage Enemy Comms rule can lock a player out of it for the rest of the battle

name: Counter-offensive
text: Use right after an enemy unit finishes fighting. Pick one of your units in Engagement Range that has not fought this phase; it fights next, ahead of the normal alternation of unit selection.

combatPatrol.note: usable by any CP unit in Engagement Range that has not yet fought

name: Epic Challenge
text: Use when one of your Character units is selected to fight while within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units that have a leader attached. Pick one Character model in that unit; until the end of the phase its melee attacks gain the Precision ability.

combatPatrol.note: usable by any CHARACTER unit (Captain Octavius, Librarian Tantus, Warboss Gordrang) fighting an enemy attached unit

name: Insane Bravery
text: Use before one of your units takes a Battle-shock test. That test is automatically passed.

combatPatrol.note: Display of Might's Break Their Spirit rule restricts the target to a unit within 6" of its Warlord

name: Grenade
text: Use in your Shooting phase, before a unit shoots. Pick one GRENADES model, in a unit that has not been selected to shoot and has not Advanced or Fallen Back this turn, and an enemy unit within 8 inches of and visible to it that is not within Engagement Range of any of your units. Roll six dice; that enemy unit suffers a mortal wound for each 4+ rolled.

combatPatrol.note: no unit in either CP roster has the GRENADES keyword

name: Tank Shock
text: Use after one of your VEHICLE units finishes a Charge move. Pick an enemy unit within Engagement Range of it and one of your VEHICLE models within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. Roll a number of dice equal to that model's Toughness; the enemy unit suffers a mortal wound for each 5+, to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds.

combatPatrol.note: usable only by Ork VEHICLE units: Deffkoptas roll 6 dice, Deff Dread rolls 9 dice; both capped at 6 mortal wounds

name: Rapid Ingress
text: Use at the end of the opponent's Movement phase. Pick one of your units in Reserves; it arrives now, as though this were your Reinforcements step (Deep Strike placement still applies if the unit has that ability).

combatPatrol.note: cannot bring a unit on in a round it could not normally arrive in (Combat Patrol: never round 1, R-5.14)

name: Fire Overwatch
text: Use when an enemy unit is set up on the battlefield, or starts or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, or starts or ends a Charge move. Pick one of your units within 24 inches of it that would be eligible to shoot in your Shooting phase; if the enemy unit is visible to it, that unit shoots as though it were your Shooting phase, except every attack hits only on an unmodified 6.

combatPatrol.note: usable by any CP unit eligible to shoot

name: Go to Ground
text: Use when one of your Infantry units is chosen as the target of a ranged attack. Until the end of the phase that unit has a 6+ invulnerable save and Benefit of Cover.

combatPatrol.note: usable by any INFANTRY unit; most units in both CP rosters qualify

name: Smokescreen
text: Use when one of your SMOKE units is chosen as the target of a ranged attack. Until the end of the phase that unit has Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability.

combatPatrol.note: no unit in either CP roster has the SMOKE keyword

name: Heroic Intervention
text: Use right after an enemy unit finishes a Charge move. Pick one of your units within 6 inches of it that is not in Engagement Range, has not Advanced or Fallen Back this turn, and would otherwise be eligible to declare a charge; it declares and resolves a charge against only that enemy unit, as though it were your Charge phase, but gains no Fights First bonus for it.

combatPatrol.note: a VEHICLE may only use it if it also has the WALKER keyword (Deff Dread)
